name: mapping_solve
description: Full deep mapping: drive the real capture screen with the synthetic camera AND synthetic IMU (a body-frame inertial stream consistent with the same pose arc), let detections + IMU accumulate over the sweep, then run the real on-device VIO solve and assert a solved map — LED positions actually recovered, end to end through the app. Needs a connected device.

steps.description: let the synthetic arc + IMU accumulate, then end + run the VIO solve
